CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting - Conference Room: 2nd Floor
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. 1st St., Alhambra, CA 91801

February 28, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  Absent:  None
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang
C.  CONSENT AGENDA

  All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design
  Review Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the
  Discussion Agenda.

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  ITEM 1: 1215 West Alhambra Road

  •  Request: Exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence.

  •  Applicant: Miguel Campa

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the
  existing awning shall be retained at the replacement windows.

  •  Discussion:
  Hernandez questioned the intention of the south elevation on Alhambra Road,
  especially as it relates to the existing awning.

  The applicant stated that he intends to retain the window frames and create a faux
  window with closed shutters within the existing window frames.

  Udani asked for clarification for the other alterations.

  The applicant stated that the east-facing windows will be reduced in height due to
  the remodeled floor plan. The style and frame would be specified to match.

  1
   Hernandez confirmed that there will be no other stucco work.

  Daninger confirmed that all colors will be painted to match the existing house.

  Tsai supported the design.

  The owner gave some history of the house and justified some of the design decisions.

  MOTION:

  o Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1.
  The existing awning shall be retained; 2. The creation of a faux window shall use
  the existing window frames with decorative shutters; 3. All revisions will be
  documented and approved by DRB staff.
  o The second was by Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

E.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:45 P.M. to the next
  meeting on March 14, 2023.

  MOTION:

  o Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:45 P.M.
  o The second was by Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 14th day of March, 2023.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
